dominant_strengths: Faithful Apple nav and SF-style typography deliver instant brand recognition and authoritative hierarchy across the marketing block.
Clean centered composition with generous whitespace lets the product hero (laptop on hand) breathe and command attention.
Dual CTA pattern (filled Learn more + ghost Buy) follows Apple's exact behavioral conventions, making interaction predictable.
dominant_weaknesses: Acidic yellow-green wallpaper clashes with the cool blue CTA and pastel iPhone strip above, fracturing palette cohesion.
Hero is a static screenshot with no motion, parallax, or scroll cue — feels like a flat catalog page versus Apple's choreographed reveals.
Concept is derivative: 'MacBook Neo' is a renamed MacBook Air clone with no distinctive visual idea or narrative tension.
fix_priorities: Harmonize palette: tone the green wallpaper toward a more neutral gradient or echo it in subtle accent elements elsewhere.
Introduce scroll-triggered motion (laptop lift, lid rotation, color shift) to match Apple's signature kinetic storytelling.
Differentiate the product story with a unique angle, typographic moment, or interactive demo beyond a stock hero shot.
Tighten vertical rhythm between the iPhone block and MacBook section — the hard cut feels like two unrelated pages stacked.
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral execution is strong via familiar Apple patterns, but visceral punch is muted by palette clash and reflective depth is shallow due to derivative concept.
rationale.intent_fit: It convincingly mimics an Apple home-scroll surface in structure and type, but lacks the kinetic craft and distinctive product narrative that define the real thing.
